name: hive
description: 子代理面板：預設只觀察子代理的動作與結果；選用 mattpocock-skills 工作流時，再畫出票、時間步與進度。

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: none: only observe subagents; mattpocock-skills: draw the tickets and steps of the mattpocock-skills workflow

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: on: while a subagent runs, the status dots, ticket icons and feature bar move; off: the pane stays still

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the pane's own text: en (English), zh-TW (繁體中文), ja (日本語)
